            0x20: 0x00,  # CTRL1
            0x21: 0x04,  # CTRL2
            0x23: 0x00,  # CTRL4_INT1_PAD_CTRL
            0x24: 0x00,  # CTRL5_INT2_PAD_CTRL
            0x26: 0x00,  # OUT_T
            0x27: 0x00,  # STATUS
            0x2E: 0x00,  # FIFO_CTRL
            0x2F: 0x00,  # FIFO_SAMPLES
            0x38: 0x00,  # WAKE_UP_SRC
            0x3C: 0x00,  # X_OFS_USR
            0x3D: 0x00,  # Y_OFS_USR
            0x3E: 0x00   # Z_OFS_USR
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:

        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")
        
        # 根据寄存器地址和字节长度返回对应的值
        value = self.regs.get(addr)
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF  # 返回高 8 位
        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        # 确保寄存器地址在有效范围内
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")

            value = self.regs.get(addr)
            value &= 0xFF00  # 清除低 8 位
            value |= data  # 更新高 8 位
        else:
            value = data
        
        # 更新寄存器值
        self.regs[addr] = value
